title: DuoQ: A DSP Utilization-aware and Outlier-free Quantization for FPGA-based LLMs Acceleration
problem: Quantization for FPGA-based LLM acceleration faces challenges from quantization outliers affecting accuracy. Existing methods use expensive channel-wise or token-wise isolation and encoding for outlier handling.
motivation: FPGAs offer efficient LLM deployment but outlier-aware quantization introduces overhead; efficient outlier elimination enables per-tensor quantization.
method: DuoQ introduces learnable equivalent transformations and low-semantic token awareness eliminating outliers while enabling per-tensor 4-bit quantization. Algorithm-hardware co-design includes DSP-aware processing element (PE) unit and encoder, plus post-processing units for nonlinear functions and dynamic token awareness.
key_novelty: Learnable equivalent transformations for outlier elimination enabling efficient per-tensor quantization without expensive isolation, co-designed with DSP-aware PEs.
contributions: Learnable equivalent transformations for outlier elimination
DSP-aware PE and encoder design for FPGA
Post-processing units for nonlinear functions and dynamic awareness
primary_theme: Outlier-free quantization for FPGA-based LLM acceleration with DSP co-design
